description: Test a statement against one cell, such as whether a value in a draft or an answer is right. The verdict is `matches`, `differs` (with what the source states), `disputed` (sources disagree, see `conflicts`) or `unknown` (no acceptable source stated it, so say so). It compares values and doesn't judge meaning, so read the quote before relying on a text verdict. Use list_tables and get_table to find the cell first.
name: check_claim
